measured_development_findings: V4 explicit reads can return a forward declaration or only the first 35 lines of a larger function, despite the agent requesting that function.
Actual V4 base64 tail and printf integer-precision trials exhausted their repair budgets on nonexistent anchors; dynamic-field handling fixed width but introduced a new zero-precision regression.
Increasing overall context is a separate candidate from selecting full definitions; measure both with the same resource limits.
changes: Make the existing model context character budget explicit in plans, CLI, manifests, exports and replay, preserving 60000 by default.
Scale per-inspection and retained-evidence limits with the configured packet budget; 60000 preserves V4 10000/18000 limits.

Optionally resolve model-requested C++ symbols to actual function/template/operator definitions or small exact-named classes using a pinned native syntax parser. Preserve all tracked-path/allowlist/scan limits.
Use exact original source lines, bounded complete definitions where they fit, and an explicit partial-neighborhood fallback when they do not. Never use evaluator mutation locations.
Measure an explicitly more expensive adaptive arm with four repair attempts and six total inspections, still two inspections per repair round; do not claim equal inference budgets.
parser_selection: Latest core0.26.0 reproducibly crashed in an isolated real-header API probe; core0.25.2 passed480 repeated parses. Research, raw errors and official wheel references are retained separately.
grading: Unchanged guarded native suites, complete baseline-test retention, protected upstream tests/config, final rebase/retest and actual tested/pushed/PR head agreement.
claim_limit: Compare the two V5 arms to isolate definition lookup at a common larger budget. V4 versus V5 combines context/evidence budgets, so do not attribute the difference solely to a parser.
